SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CMP_MSG_ID AS msgid, CASE WHEN USED_CD IN ('00', '10', '20') THEN 'PH' WHEN USED_CD = '30' THEN 'AT' WHEN USED_CD = '40' THEN 'G1' END AS messagetype, CASE WHEN USED_CD = '00' THEN 'S' WHEN USED_CD = '10' THEN 'L' WHEN USED_CD = '20' THEN 'M' END AS smskind, SND_MSG AS msgsms, CASE WHEN RCV_PHN_ID LIKE '82%' THEN RCV_PHN_ID WHEN RCV_PHN_ID LIKE '010%' THEN '82' || SUBSTR(RCV_PHN_ID, 2, 15) ELSE '82' || SUBSTR(RCV_PHN_ID, 2, 15) END AS phn, SND_PHN_ID AS smssender, CASE WHEN RESERVED_FG = 'R' THEN RESERVED_DTTM ELSE '00000000000000' END AS reservedt, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regdt, MSG_TITLE AS title FROM ${msg_table} WHERE SMS_STATUS = '0' AND ( RESERVED_FG = 'I' OR (RESERVED_FG = 'R' AND RESERVED_DTTM <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) )
ORDER BY CMP_MSG_ID ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 200
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = UPPER(#{logTable})
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${logTable} AS SELECT * FROM ${msgTable} WHERE 1 = 2
